name: boughkeeper-buff-icon
description: Native check of Boughkeeper's buff icon. The main character of a disposable fixture save is armed with Boughkeeper, the game queues a real attack of opportunity against a disposable hostile target and the harness runs that native command while paused, with the attack bonus raised so the hit is certain. The hit must grant the Boughkeeper armor-class buff; the portrait's buff slot must show it after that first hit and draw the Elven Branched Spear sprite the buff blueprint carries, and the tooltip the slot opens must be the buff's own. The fight is then ended and play resumed: the buff must end by itself within 25 s and the armor class must return to its value before the hit. Screenshots of the party bar and the tooltip are written beside the harness result for a person to look at; the verdict comes from the game's own view objects. On a build where the buff has no icon or no effect links the session fails by design.
